verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security SaaS that handles customer data and ships AI features (Fieldwork AI agents, an MCP server), so a no-training guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI model training, data-use opt-outs, or training exclusions. The OAuth, RBAC and service-key scoping evidence covers access control, not training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
